name: Ferry passengers
textTemplate: {pax} travelers ask to be taken to {dest} in the {system} system, in return for {pay} credits.

name: Rush delivery
textTemplate: A trader needs {tons} t of {cargo} on {dest} in the {system} system right away, and will pay {pay} credits if you are on time.

name: Cargo transport
textTemplate: A merchant wants {tons} t of {cargo} hauled to {dest} in the {system} system for {pay} credits.

name: Cargo shipment
textTemplate: A large shipment of {tons} t of {cargo} must reach {dest} in the {system} system. The pay is {pay} credits.

name: Cargo delivery
textTemplate: A shopkeeper asks you to carry {tons} t of {cargo} to {dest} in the {system} system for {pay} credits.

name: Dump garbage
textTemplate: A port official pays {pay} credits up front for you to haul {tons} t of garbage to {dest} in the {system} system and ask no questions.
